facts.fact: The GOGLA country brief states that the Ghana Standards Authority (GSA) is the national standards body in Ghana; it gives no date for this, so the document's published date of 2024-01-01 is used.

note: The GSA standards catalogue is said to list quality standards for solar devices only, which is not an IT or data standard; the Energy Commission product certification requirement concerns solar products, so nothing on published or certification.
